texte.# % la part pondérée des champs déclarés: # % the weighted share of the fields declared, # % the number of clues found word for word in the declaration (capped at three). The confidence the engine announces does not enter into it.
texte.Accès réussi, malveillant et non autoris: Successful, malicious and unauthorised access to network and information systems, liable to cause data losses
texte.Acquisition, développement et maintenanc: Acquisition, development and maintenance of ICT systems
texte.Acte délégué C(#) # de la Commission du: Commission delegated act C(#) # of # February #
texte.Acte délégué C(#) #, article #, §#, renv: Delegated act C(#) #, article #(#), referring to article #(#)(d)(i) of DORA
texte.Actions pour traiter les risques liés au: Actions to address the risks bearing on how the management system runs
texte.Administration des systèmes d'informatio: Administration of information systems from dedicated resources
texte.Administrer depuis un poste dédié, sur u: Administering from a dedicated workstation, on a dedicated network — twelve means, none of them expected of an important entity.
texte.Affectez-vous effectivement deux personn: Do you in fact assign two separate natural persons, with the competences declared in the instructions for use, to the review of every identification output — and does your configuration of the system not bring the review back down to a single person?
texte.Aligne huit directives sectorielles fina: Aligns eight sectoral financial directives on digital operational resilience.
Annual, in euro, in a single instalment. The debit notes allow at least thirty days.
texte.Approche « tous risques » — protéger les: An « all-hazards » approach — protecting network and information systems AND their physical environment.
texte.Après les recommandations de l'article #: After the recommendations of article #(#)(d), submit a report containing a REMEDIAL ACTION PLAN, in line with the timetable the lead overseer sets for each recommendation, then report on its implementation.
texte.Art. # §# et annexe I — composant de séc: Art. #(#) and Annex I — safety component of a regulated product
texte.Art. # §# et annexe III — domaines à hau: Art. #(#) and Annex III — high-risk areas
texte.Article # — c'est là que les scénarios d: Article # — this is where risk scenarios are identified, estimated and evaluated, and where the risk-management file on which the oversight measures are calibrated lives.
texte.Article # — la conception, la vérificati: Article # — the design, verification and modification of the oversight measures, and the monitoring of their effectiveness after they are placed on the market, come under this system.
texte.Article # — la journalisation sur laquel: Article # — the logging on which every oversight review rests, including the recording of interventions.
texte.Article # — la notice d'utilisation, c'e: Article # — the instructions for use, that is, the vehicle through which the obligations that depend on deployment pass from the provider to the deployer.
texte.Article # — signalement des vulnérabilit: Article # — reporting of actively exploited vulnerabilities and of severe incidents
texte.Article #, paragraphe # — l'autorité com: Article #(#) — the competent authority may set the deferral aside for other important or systemic entities. The decision is notified and applies only to incidents reported after that notification.
texte.Article #, paragraphe # — le report ne s: Article #(#) — the deferral does not apply to the initial notification or to the intermediate report of credit institutions, central counterparties, trading venues, or essential or important entities within the meaning of article # of Directive (EU) #/#.
texte.Article #, paragraphe #, qui renvoie à l: Article #(#), which refers to the implementing act of article #, first subparagraph, point (a)(ii).
texte.Articles # et #, qui renvoient à des nor: Articles # and #, which refer to technical standards.
texte.Assistance en cas d'incident lié aux TIC: Assistance in the event of an ICT-related incident, at no additional cost or at a cost determined in advance
texte.Assister le superviseur principal dans l: Assisting the lead overseer in the assessment provided for in article #(#) of DORA
Assisting the lead overseer in preparing the annual individual oversight plan (DORA, article #(#))
texte.Assurance, sous-traitance, clause contra: Insurance, subcontracting, a contractual clause. The risk is still borne by the organisation: sharing moves the financial burden, not the responsibility.
texte.Assurer la protection des réseaux et sys: Ensuring the protection of network and information systems, including where subcontracting is used
texte.Atteinte durable à l'activité, aux perso: Lasting harm to the business, to people or to reputation; the organisation's survival in question.
texte.Au moins deux occurrences en six mois: At least two occurrences in six months
texte.Au moins un scénario de risque a une lat: At least one risk scenario has an intervention latency longer than its reaction time, with no record of the technical impossibility in the risk-management file. Human oversight is not a risk-management measure there.
texte.Au moins un sous-critère de seuil n'est: At least one threshold sub-criterion is not met. Delegated act C(#) # requires them ALL to be met before moving to step #: the designation cannot go through as things stand.
texte.Au moins une des quatre exclusions de l': At least one of the four exclusions in article #(#) applies. The designation is closed, whatever the market share.
texte.Au plus tard soixante-douze heures après: Within seventy-two hours of the initial notification being submitted, even if nothing has changed. Then an update without undue delay, and in any event once regular activities have resumed.
texte.Au plus tard un mois après la soumission: Within one month of the intermediate report, or of its latest update, being submitted.
texte.Au-delà de ce niveau (vraisemblance × co: Above this level (likelihood × consequence), the risk cannot simply be retained: it calls for treatment.
texte.Au-delà de la petite entreprise et en de: Above a small enterprise and below the large-enterprise thresholds, within the meaning of article #.
texte.Aucun cas connu dans l'organisme ni dans: No known case in the organisation or in its sector; it would take a combination of circumstances.
texte.Aucun des écarts que ce module sait mesu: None of the gaps this module can measure is still open.
texte.Aucun indice n'est avancé à l'appui de l: No clue is put forward in support of the proposal.
texte.Aucun prestataire critique ne paie moins: No critical provider pays less than # # EUR a year, whatever its turnover.
texte.Aucun. L'autorité exerce ses pouvoirs de: None. The authority exercises its oversight powers without having to establish a prior breach.
texte.Aucune approche n'est retenue pour cette: No approach is chosen for this essential requirement.
texte.Aucune des cinq catégories de l'article: None of the five categories in article #(#) is declared.
texte.Aucune intervention humaine ne rentre da: No human intervention fits within that deadline, and the impossibility is recorded in the risk-management file. Oversight does not carry this risk: other measures have to carry it.
texte.Aucune mesure de l'annexe A ne le rencon: No Annex A control meets it. This is an application-level risk, and # is a management system.
texte.Audits ad hoc, notamment après un incide: Ad hoc audits, in particular after a significant incident
texte.Audits de sécurité ciblés, par un organi: Targeted security audits, by an independent body or by the authority
texte.Audits de sécurité réguliers ET ciblés,: Regular AND targeted security audits, by an independent body or by the authority
texte.Auto-évaluable SI le fabricant applique: Self-assessable IF the manufacturer applies in full the relevant harmonised standards, common specifications or certification schemes. Otherwise, a notified body.
texte.Autoévaluation de la substituabilité de: Self-assessment of how substitutable each service is, and knowledge of the other providers able to deliver it
texte.Autres règles de l'Union couvrant les mê: Other Union rules covering the same risks to at least an equivalent level
texte.Autres éléments des systèmes, protocoles: Other elements of the systems, protocols and tools intended to minimise the impact of ICT risk
texte.Avant de coter, savoir ce qui est déjà p: Before scoring, know what is already produced. Learning it afterwards means scoring the same clauses twice.
texte.Avez-vous déterminé la durée de conserva: Have you determined the retention period, the filtering and aggregation capabilities, the alerting mechanisms, the review functions and the traceability between each output, its input, its review and the corrective action?
texte.Avez-vous déterminé, pour CHAQUE scénari: Have you determined, for EACH scenario, the reaction time, taking your risk acceptability criteria into account?
texte.Avez-vous identifié, au niveau logique o: Have you identified, at the logical or functional level, the scenarios where an output of the system can lead to harm and where human oversight is needed to prevent or mitigate it?
texte.Avez-vous lu les risques résiduels et le: Have you read the residual risks and the conditions of use in the instructions, and do you meet them — or have you formally accepted the risks you do not cover?
texte.Avez-vous mis en œuvre CHAQUE mesure de: Have you implemented EVERY oversight measure the instructions for use assign to you, with the technical means, the procedures and the organisation they specify?
texte.Avez-vous reçu de votre fournisseur une: Have you received from your provider instructions for use that carry this oversight information — and, where they are silent on one of the points, have you asked for it in writing?
texte.Avez-vous sélectionné au moins une mesur: Have you selected at least one measure per scenario, checked that they are COLLECTIVELY sufficient to allow intervention within the deadline, and documented that choice in the risk-management file?
texte.Avez-vous testé si vos mesures maintienn: Have you tested whether your measures keep passive acceptance within acceptable bounds — for instance by presenting representative people with a mix of correct and deliberately wrong outputs, and measuring what gets through?
texte.Avez-vous vérifié que les personnes dési: Have you checked that the designated persons carry out the key oversight tasks WITHIN the reaction time, with defined acceptance criteria and results recorded in the technical documentation?

Have you checked that the designated persons spot incorrect or hazardous outputs and act WITHIN the reaction time, defined acceptance criteria, dealt with the gaps before placing on the market, and planned how the review carries on if the main interface or the logging fails?
texte.Avez-vous vérifié, par les méthodes que: Have you checked, by the methods the instructions recommend, that each measure does run on your side AND that it produces the expected effect, against the performance criteria they give?
texte.Avez-vous établi, par écrit, quelles exi: Have you established, in writing, which regulatory requirements apply to each of your AI systems?
texte.C'EST LA SOURCE. La qualification assist: THIS IS THE SOURCE. Assisted qualification, FinOps and the footprint keep no inventory of their own: they read this one.
texte.C'est ce que le score compte, et ce que: This is what the score counts, and what the action plan takes up line by line.
texte.C'est ce qui sépare une évolution prévue: This is what separates a planned change from a substantial modification that reopens the conformity assessment.
texte.C'est l'alinéa #(#) du règlement : la vé: This is subparagraph #(#) of the Regulation: separate verification by at least two persons. « Technically » means that a procedure is not enough.
texte.C'est l'alinéa #(#)(b) du règlement. Une: This is subparagraph #(#)(b) of the Regulation. A person who approves everything out of habit is not a risk-management measure, even if they click.
texte.C'est l'alinéa #(#)(c). Un score de conf: This is subparagraph #(#)(c). A confidence score nobody knows how to read helps no one, and competences that are assumed but not declared will not be hired.
texte.C'est l'alinéa #(#)(d) et (e). Sans fonc: This is subparagraph #(#)(d) and (e). Without an intervention function, oversight comes down to watching.
texte.C'est l'alinéa (f) de l'article #(#), et: This is subparagraph (f) of article #(#), and it refers to article #: the whole governance of the data sets.
texte.C'est l'alinéa (j) de l'article #(#). Le: This is subparagraph (j) of article #(#). On the day of a serious incident, it is the only path that counts.
texte.C'est l'alinéa (l) de l'article #(#). Un: This is subparagraph (l) of article #(#). A foundation model bought off the shelf is part of it.
texte.C'est l'arithmétique du module : une app: This is the module's arithmetic: an « other » approach with no justification and no objective evidence caps the score, because the standard itself requires them at #.
texte.C'est l'artefact que l'auditeur ouvre en: This is the artefact the auditor opens first.
texte.C'est l'audit que le taux de conformité: This is the audit that the AI Act compliance rate reads.
texte.C'est l'aveu recevable. Confier une resp: This is the admissible admission. Giving an oversight responsibility to someone who physically has no time to intervene is not a risk-management measure — and claiming otherwise creates exposure.
texte.C'est l'objet même du règlement, et ce q: This is the very subject of the Regulation, and what the authority opens first.
texte.C'est l'obligation du règlement qui s'ap: This is the obligation of the Regulation that applies first.
texte.C'est la classification que le registre: This is the classification the register takes up, and that FinOps sorts by risk level.
texte.C'est la fonction minimale : elle suppos: This is the minimum function: it assumes the output goes through a gate before it acts.
texte.C'est la fonction que la norme rend OBLI: This is the function the standard makes MANDATORY in addition to the others. A trigger that depends on the system it is meant to stop is not one.
texte.C'est la forme que la transposition fran: This is the shape the French transposition is preparing. The rate that comes out of it is a READINESS rate, kept apart from every other.
texte.C'est la même logique que pour la revue: This is the same logic as for the retrospective review: an unverified interface is an assumption about human behaviour.
texte.C'est la pièce que ni ISO # ni ISO/IEC #: This is the document that neither ISO # nor ISO/IEC # gives, and the one the notified body opens first. The approach chosen GOVERNS the burden of proof: « another standard » and « another solution » additionally call for what is not covered, the justification and the objective evidence.
texte.C'est la pièce qui n'a d'équivalent ni d: This is the document that has no counterpart in either ISO # or ISO/IEC #: a QMS carried over as it stands from an existing certificate does not hold it.
texte.C'est la racine de tout le reste : le dé: This is the root of everything else: the reaction time, the choice of measure categories and the verification are all calibrated scenario by scenario.
texte.C'est la restitution : rien ne s'y saisi: This is the read-out: nothing is entered here, everything is derived from what comes before.
texte.C'est la seule partie du cadre qui se CA: This is the only part of the framework that is CALCULATED: the declared latency against the declared deadline.
texte.C'est la seule vue qui dise ce que le tr: This is the only view that says what the work done COVERS of the Regulation, and not what it covers of the standard.
texte.C'est le chemin le plus court pour livre: This is the shortest path to delivery, and an authorisation scope never narrows afterwards.
texte.C'est le critère qui décide quelle catég: This is the criterion that decides which category of measure can hold the scenario. A deadline in milliseconds and a deadline in days do not call for the same oversight.
texte.C'est le cœur du règlement, et ce que la: This is the heart of the Regulation, and what the technical documentation will have to demonstrate.
texte.C'est le seul article qui expose personn: This is the only article that exposes senior management personally.
texte.C'est le seul moyen de savoir si la conc: It is the only way to know whether the design works: automation bias is not declared, it is measured.
